  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
Technology and Telematics

Porsche Marin is pleased to present this exceptionally well-equipped Porsche Taycan 4 Cross Turismo, finished in Jet Black Metallic over a refined Black and Chalk Leather interior. Blending all-electric performance with the versatility of a Cross Turismo design, this Taycan 4 delivers dynamic capability, advanced technology, and everyday practicality in unmistakable Porsche fashion.

Powered by dual electric motors and Porsches all-wheel-drive system, the Taycan 4 Cross Turismo offers instantaneous torque and seamless acceleration. The Sport Chrono Package sharpens responsiveness and driving dynamics, while the 150 kW/400V DC on-board charger enhances charging capability for added convenience. Riding on 19" Taycan S Aero Wheels, this example balances aerodynamic efficiency with purposeful styling.

The Premium Package and Tech Package elevate both comfort and innovation, incorporating features such as Surround View, Ambient Lighting, Power Folding Exterior Mirrors, and an Ionizer for enhanced cabin air quality. Porsche Dynamic Light System Plus (PDLS+) provides exceptional nighttime visibility, further complementing the vehicles sleek Jet Black Metallic exterior.

Power Seats (14-way) with Memory Package, ventilated front seats, and a Heated GT Sport Steering Wheel ensure driver-focused comfort, while Rear 2+1 Seating increases versatility for passengers. Theres a theatrical kind of muscle to the 2022 Ford F150 Lariat Shelby a pickup that behaves like a headline act dressed in tailored denim. Its the sort of truck that refuses to be anonymous in a sea of silver slabs: broader stance, purposeful shoulders, and details that announce intent without a single shouted badge. From a distance it reads as capability refined into character rugged geometry softened by careful accents, a stance that looks ready to haul yet somehow conspires to look effortlessly cool while doing it.

Step closer and the Shelby touches reveal themselves like punctuation: contrast stripes that carve the hood into attitude, trim that borrows from sportscar theater, and wheels that seem to crouch in anticipation. Its a look that flirts with performance and utility at the same time a workmate by day and a weekend provocateur by sundown. The exterior plays both roles well, mixing utilitarian honesty with flashes of bravado that make the truck feel less like a tool and more like a personality.

Open the door and the cabin continues the act, swapping tack for tactility. Leather and contrast stitching settle around you like a familiar jacket, controls sit where a practiced hand expects them, and small luxuriesmetallic accents, thoughtful storage, and a drivers vantage that feels both commanding and humanremind you this is as much about comfort as capability. The interior doesnt hide its purpose: its made for work, but it understands pleasure. Conversation, playlists, and the quiet hum of a long highway mile are all part of the program.

On the road the Lariat Shelby is dramatic without being needy. Its motions are deliberate, rewarding decisive inputs with a satisfying sense of connection to the road. It leans into corners with unexpected poise for its size, settles into long runs with calm authority, and makes city maneuvers feel less like chores and more like choreography. Sound plays its part too a chesty note that arrives when the mood is right and otherwise allows the cabins calm to do its work.

Practicality remains honest: bed space that behaves, configurations that adapt, and a presence that makes towing look like a confident afterthought. But the lasting impression is temperament this F150 blends usefulness with a theatrical wink. Its a truck for people who want to work hard and arrive like they meant to.

description: The 2023 Lucid Air Pure Sedan 4‑door is Lucid’s entry‑level luxury electric sedan — a masterclass in efficiency, comfort, and understated design. Boasting a single rear‑wheel drive motor outputting 430 hp (406 lb‑ft), it rockets from 0 to 60 mph in approximately 4.5 seconds and reaches a top speed of about 124 mph. Developing sleek aerodynamic efficiency with a drag coefficient of just 0.197 and weighing in around 4,560 lb, it achieves an EPA‑estimated range of up to 420 miles on 19‑inch aero wheels — meaning owners can expect real‑world highway range in the high‑300s to low‑400s, depending on driving conditions. Inside, the Air Pure delivers a spacious, minimalist cabin with a Mojave PurLuxe trim theme, and a sweeping 34‑inch curved Glass Cockpit paired with a flip‑up Pilot Panel touchscreen for climate and vehicle controls. While some premium features—such as ventilated massaging seats, power frunk, soft‑close doors, and a leather‑wrapped steering wheel—are reserved for higher trims, the Pure still offers heated front seats, wireless Apple CarPlay/Android Auto, and a refined, quiet ride aided by adaptive suspension and torque vectoring. Efficiency is a key forte: Tom’s Guide awarded the 2025 “Most Efficient” EV title to the Air Pure, noting up to 4.0 mi/kWh (or about 146 MPGe), an industry‑leading figure for a production vehicle (Tom's Guide). Coupled with ultra‑fast charging—add around 200 miles of range in about 17 minutes using a 250 kW+ DC fast charger—it’s geared for long‑distance travel with minimal downtime. In essence, the 2023 Lucid Air Pure Sedan is a precision‑engineered EV that offers superb long‑range performance and a tranquil, high‑quality cabin—all at a starting price that positions it as Lucid’s most attainable luxury model.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.

Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. The exterior of this Charger exudes a bold and aggressive stance, complemented by the striking Silver paint and a host of premium Daytona-inspired design elements. The 20-inch forged and painted aluminum wheels further accentuate the vehicle's sporty and refined appearance.

Step inside the cabin, and you'll be greeted by a wealth of premium features that elevate the driving experience. The Nappa leather and Alcantara-trimmed seats provide exceptional comfort and support, while the heated and ventilated front seats ensure a personalized climate experience. The Uconnect 4C infotainment system with an 8.4-inch display offers intuitive connectivity, seamless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration, and a premium audio system.

Safety is also a top priority, with advanced features like Blind Spot Monitoring, Rear Cross-Traffic Alert, and a ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera ensuring your peace of mind on the road.

This 2021 Dodge Charger R/T Scat Pack is a true performance-focused sedan that combines exhilarating power, refined styling, and a wealth of premium amenities. Experience the thrill of driving this exceptional vehicle and schedule a test drive today. We're confident you'll be impressed by its capabilities and eager to make it your own.
